definition_en: Past tense and past participle of lend, meaning to give something temporarily to someone else.
example_en: He lent me his car for the weekend so I could travel.
example_uz: U menga dam olish kunlari sayohat qilishim uchun mashinasini qarzga berdi.

definition_en: To make a low, continuous humming sound or to speak in a flat, boring voice.
example_en: The professor continued to drone on about boring history for an hour.
example_uz: Professor bir soat davomida zerikarli tarix haqida bir xil ohangda gapirib berdi.

definition_en: A passionate partner dance that originated in Argentina, usually performed to dramatic music.
example_en: They learned how to dance the tango at a local studio together.
example_uz: Ular mahalliy studiyada birgalikda tango raqsiga tushishni oʻrganishdi.

definition_en: For all future time; in a way that will not change or be replaced.
example_en: The company decided to close the office and move permanently to online.
example_uz: Kompaniya ofisni yopishga va butunlay onlayn ish rejimiga oʻtishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: Past tense of skip, meaning to intentionally not do or attend something.
example_en: He skipped his morning class because he felt very tired and unwell.
example_uz: U oʻzini juda charchagan va betob his qilgani uchun ertalabki darsni oʻtkazib yubordi.

definition_en: A small, juicy, red fruit with seeds on its outside surface.
example_en: Fresh strawberries taste delicious when mixed with a little bit of cream.
example_uz: Yangi uzilgan qulupnay ozgina qaymoq bilan aralashtirilsa, juda mazali boʻladi.

definition_en: Feeling that something is too much to manage or feeling very strong emotions.
example_en: I felt overwhelmed by the amount of work I had to do today.
example_uz: Bugun bajarishim kerak boʻlgan ishlar koʻpligidan oʻzimni yoʻqotib qoʻydim.

definition_en: Containing a substance that can cause illness or death if eaten or touched.
example_en: Be careful because some mushrooms in this forest are very poisonous.
example_uz: Ehtiyot bo'ling chunki bu o'rmondagi ba'zi zamburug'lar juda zaharli.

definition_en: Coming after the eighth item in a series or order.
example_en: My birthday is on the ninth of May every single year.
example_uz: Tug'ilgan kunim har yili may oyining to'qqizinchi sanasida nishonlanadi.

definition_en: A type of small, fast-flying hawk found in northern parts of the world.
example_en: The merlin is a fierce predator despite its relatively small size.
example_uz: Lochinkush kichik bo'lishiga qaramay, juda shiddatli yirtqich qush hisoblanadi.

definition_en: To make a motor run at a higher speed while the vehicle is standing still.
example_en: He was revving the engine before starting his long drive home.
example_uz: U uzoq yo'lga chiqishdan oldin mashina dvigatelini qizdirib, gazni bosib turdi.

definition_en: Giving a feeling of comfort, warmth, and relaxation.
example_en: It is such a cozy little room with a soft fireplace.
example_uz: Bu kaminli juda shinam va qulay xonacha ekan.

definition_en: The hard structure of bones that supports a human or animal body.
example_en: The human skeleton consists of more than two hundred different bones.
example_uz: Inson skeleti ikki yuzdan ortiq suyakdan tashkil topgan.

definition_en: To think about something again in order to possibly change your decision.
example_en: Please reconsider your decision to move to another city alone.
example_uz: Iltimos, yolg'iz boshqa shaharga ko'chib o'tish qaroringizni qayta o'ylab ko'ring.

definition_en: To make a high, sharp sound when moved under pressure.
example_en: The old wooden floor always creaks when you walk across it.
example_uz: Eski yog'och pol ustida yurganingizda doim g'ijirlaydi.

definition_en: A long pole with a sharp pointed blade used for hunting or fighting.
example_en: Ancient hunters used a sharp spear to catch fish in rivers.
example_uz: Qadimiy ovchilar daryolarda baliq tutish uchun o'tkir nayzadan foydalanishgan.

definition_en: Over the side of a boat or ship into the water.
example_en: The sailor accidentally fell overboard during the heavy storm at sea.
example_uz: Dengizdagi kuchli bo'ron paytida dengizchi tasodifan kemadan suvga yiqilib tushdi.

definition_en: Bags and cases that you carry with you when you are traveling on a trip.
example_en: Please put all your heavy baggage in the back of the car.
example_uz: Iltimos, hamma og'ir yuklaringizni mashinaning orqasiga joylab qo'ying.

definition_en: A very unpleasant, dishonest, or morally bad person.
example_en: Don't trust that scumbag; he will try to cheat you every time.
example_uz: U iflos kimsaga ishonma, u har safar seni aldashga urinadi.

definition_en: A sharp, curved nail on the foot of some animals like birds or cats.
example_en: The cat used its sharp claw to climb up the wooden fence.
example_uz: Mushuk yog'och panjaraga chiqish uchun o'tkir panjasidan foydalandi.

definition_en: A person who fights in the sport of boxing.
example_en: She trains every morning because she wants to be a professional boxer.
example_uz: U har kuni ertalab shug'ullanadi, chunki professional bokschi bo'lishni xohlaydi.

definition_en: An event or situation that causes someone to have bad luck.
example_en: She had to face a number of misfortunes throughout her life.
example_uz: U hayoti davomida ko'plab baxtsizliklarga duch keldi.

definition_en: A person who is very skilled at music or another art form.
example_en: The famous maestro conducted the symphony with great passion and energy.
example_uz: Mashhur maestro simfoniyani katta ishtiyoq va quvvat bilan dirijyorlik qildi.

definition_en: To make something less tight or less firm.
example_en: After the big meal, he decided to loosen his belt slightly.
example_uz: Katta ovqatdan so'ng, u kamarini biroz bo'shatib qo'yishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: To officially order someone to come to a specific place.
example_en: The king decided to summon all his advisors for an urgent meeting.
example_uz: Qirol barcha maslahatchilarini shoshilinch yig'ilishga chaqirishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: Done or living alone, without any other people or companions around.
example_en: He enjoyed taking long solitary walks through the quiet autumn forest.
example_uz: U tinch kuz o'rmonida yolg'iz sayr qilishni yoqtirardi.

definition_en: To disappear suddenly and become impossible to see anymore.
example_en: The magician made the rabbit vanish into thin air very quickly.
example_uz: Sehrgar quyonni bir zumda g'oyib qilib yubordi.

definition_en: Tasting very good and pleasant to eat.
example_en: This chocolate cake tastes absolutely yummy with a glass of milk.
example_uz: Bu shokoladli tort bir stakan sut bilan juda mazali.

definition_en: Not tight or firm; hanging loose because it is not pulled straight.
example_en: The rope was too slack so he tightened it to hold the tent.
example_uz: Arqon juda bo'sh edi, shuning uchun chodirni ushlab turishi uchun uni tortdim.

definition_en: To have broken suddenly with a sharp, quick sound.
example_en: The dry branch snapped under his feet as he walked along.
example_uz: U yurib ketayotganida oyog'i ostidagi quruq shox qarsillab sindi.

definition_en: The parents of your father or your mother.
example_en: I always spend my summer holidays at my grandparents' house in the village.
example_uz: Men yozgi ta'tilimni har doim qishloqdagi buvi va bobomnikida o'tkazaman.

definition_en: The number that is one more than thirteen.
example_en: I have fourteen books on my shelf in my small room.
example_uz: Mening javonimda o'n to'rtta kitob bor.

definition_en: Small, baked, sweet cakes that are usually crisp and flat.
example_en: Would you like some biscuits to go with your hot tea?
example_uz: Choyingiz bilan birga pechene yeyishni xohlaysizmi?

definition_en: A very large, powerful ape that lives in the forests of Central Africa.
example_en: The silverback gorilla is the leader of the entire family group.
example_uz: Katta yoshli erkak gorilla butun oila guruhining rahbari hisoblanadi.

definition_en: A series of rulers from the same family over a long period.
example_en: The ancient dynasty ruled the country for over three hundred years.
example_uz: Qadimiy sulola mamlakatni uch yuz yildan ortiq boshqargan.

definition_en: Too many to be measured or counted.
example_en: There are countless stars visible in the sky on a clear night.
example_uz: Ochiq osmonda tunlari sanoqsiz yulduzlarni ko'rish mumkin.

definition_en: A person whose job is to take care of a garden or grow plants.
example_en: Our gardener spends all morning watering the flowers in the backyard.
example_uz: Bogbonimiz har kuni ertalab orqa hovlidagi gullarni sug'oradi.

definition_en: A group of buildings where soldiers live.
example_en: The soldiers returned to their barracks after the long training session.
example_uz: Mashg'ulot tugagach, askarlar kazarmaga qaytishdi.

definition_en: To behave as if you are sexually attracted to someone, often in a playful way.
example_en: He likes to flirt with everyone he meets at the party.
example_uz: U ziyofatda tanishgan har bir odam bilan ko'z suzib gaplashishni yoqtiradi.

definition_en: Made by cutting patterns or shapes into wood, stone, or other hard materials.
example_en: The museum displayed a beautiful chair made of carved wood.
example_uz: Muzeyda o'ymakor yog'ochdan yasalgan chiroyli stul namoyish etildi.

definition_en: A fictional character with special powers who fights to protect other people.
example_en: Children love to dress up as their favorite superhero on holidays.
example_uz: Bolalar bayramlarda o'zlarining sevimli superqahramonlari kiyimini kiyishni yaxshi ko'rishadi.

definition_en: The act of hitting your hands together to show that you enjoyed something.
example_en: Loud clapping filled the room after the singer finished the song.
example_uz: Xonanda qo'shig'ini tugatgach, zalni qarsaklar sadosi tutib ketdi.

definition_en: Related to the study and treatment of mental illness.
example_en: He received psychiatric care at a specialized clinic for his condition.
example_uz: U o'z kasalligi uchun maxsus klinikada psixiatriya yordamini oldi.

definition_en: To go somewhere quietly and secretly to avoid being seen.
example_en: We snuck out of the house while our parents were sleeping.
example_uz: Ota-onamiz uxlab yotganida biz uydan bilintirmay chiqib ketdik.

definition_en: A king or prince in India or other parts of South Asia.
example_en: The local raja lived in a massive palace on the hill.
example_uz: Mahalliy roja tepalikdagi ulkan saroyda yashardi.

definition_en: A small, hard, or shapeless mass of something.
example_en: There is a small lump on my arm that needs checking.
example_uz: Qo‘limda tekshirtirish kerak bo‘lgan kichik bir bo‘rtiq bor.

definition_en: A person or thing that is much smaller than the normal size.
example_en: The gardener planted a dwarf variety of apple tree in the yard.
example_uz: Bog‘bon hovliga past bo‘yli olma daraxtini ekdi.

definition_en: An informal and affectionate word for a mother.
example_en: I am going to visit my mam this weekend in the country.
example_uz: Bu dam olish kunlari qishloqqa oyijonimni ko‘rgani boraman.

definition_en: A unit of liquid measurement, or a glass of beer containing this amount.
example_en: He went to the local pub to have a pint with friends.
example_uz: U do‘stlari bilan yarim litr pivo ichish uchun mahalliy barga bordi.

definition_en: Showing skill in dealing with people without causing offense or argument.
example_en: You need to be diplomatic when telling someone they made a mistake.
example_uz: Biror kishiga xato qilganini aytganda juda xushmuomala bo‘lish kerak.

definition_en: To look at something or someone steadily and for a long time.
example_en: They gazed at the beautiful sunset for a very long time.
example_uz: Ular uzoq vaqt davomida chiroyli quyosh botishiga tikilib qolishdi.

definition_en: Not showing or expressing thanks for something that someone has done for you.
example_en: It is ungrateful to ignore the help that your friends offered.
example_uz: Do'stlaringiz taklif qilgan yordamni mensimaslik noshukurlikdir.

definition_en: To make pain, worry, or a difficult situation less severe or serious.
example_en: This medicine will help to relieve the pain in your back.
example_uz: Bu dori belingizdagi og'riqni yengillatishga yordam beradi.

definition_en: The children of your son or daughter.
example_en: The grandmother loves spending time with all of her grandchildren.
example_uz: Buvi barcha nabiralari bilan vaqt o'tkazishni yaxshi ko'radi.

definition_en: Great happiness or a state of being extremely lucky and satisfied.
example_en: She found domestic felicity in her quiet life in the countryside.
example_uz: U qishloqdagi osoyishta hayotida chinakam baxtni topdi.

definition_en: In a way that is unusual or unexpected and makes you feel surprised.
example_en: The house was surprisingly small for such a very large family.
example_uz: Bu uy bunchalik katta oila uchun hayratlanarli darajada kichik edi.

definition_en: A place that is connected with a holy person or event and is visited respectfully.
example_en: Thousands of people visit the holy shrine to pray every single year.
example_uz: Minglab odamlar har yili ibodat qilish uchun muqaddas qadamjoga tashrif buyurishadi.

definition_en: A large building at a college where students live and sleep.
example_en: I lived in a university dorm during my first year of studies.
example_uz: O'qishning birinchi yilida universitet yotoqxonasida yashaganman.

definition_en: A week of formal mourning for a relative in the Jewish tradition.
example_en: The grieving family sat shiva for seven days after the funeral.
example_uz: Dafn marosimidan so'ng oila a'zolari yetti kun davomida motam tutishdi.

definition_en: A person who steals money or property using force or threats.
example_en: The bank robber ran out of the building with a bag.
example_uz: Bank o'g'risi sumka bilan binodan yugurib chiqib ketdi.

definition_en: A building where a community of religious women live together.
example_en: She decided to leave her old life and join a convent.
example_uz: U o'zining eski hayotini tark etib, monastirga kirishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: A sharp or hurtful remark intended to upset someone.
example_en: She made a sharp barb about his clothes during the meeting.
example_uz: U yig'ilish vaqtida uning kiyimiga nisbatan achchiq gap aytdi.

definition_en: A very dangerous and illegal drug that makes people feel high.
example_en: The police launched a campaign against the use of meth.
example_uz: Politsiya metamfetamin iste'moliga qarshi kurash kampaniyasini boshladi.

definition_en: A wild plant with bright red flowers that has dark seeds in the center.
example_en: The fields were filled with beautiful red poppy flowers in the spring.
example_uz: Bahorda dalalar chiroyli qizil ko'knori gullari bilan to'lib ketdi.

definition_en: To officially tell someone that they are no longer needed at their job.
example_en: The manager decided to dismiss several employees due to the budget cuts.
example_uz: Menejer budjet qisqarishi sababli bir nechta xodimni ishdan bo'shatishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: A system where people are owned by others and forced to work for them.
example_en: History shows that slavery is a violation of basic human rights.
example_uz: Tarix qullik insonning asosiy huquqlarini poymol qilishini ko'rsatadi.

definition_en: Having decorations or ornaments added to make something look more attractive.
example_en: The room was beautifully decorated with flowers and ribbons for the wedding.
example_uz: To'y uchun xona gullar va lentalar bilan chiroyli bezatilgan edi.

definition_en: A large ancient stone building with a square base and four triangular sides.
example_en: Tourists from all over the world visit the Great Pyramid in Egypt.
example_uz: Dunyoning turli burchaklaridan sayyohlar Misrdagi Buyuk piramidani ziyorat qilishadi.

definition_en: To make a continuous low sound with your lips closed, often following a melody.
example_en: We are humming happily along with the music in the car.
example_uz: Biz mashinada musiqaga qo'shilib xursand bo'lib g'o'ng'illayapmiz.

definition_en: To build something again because it was broken, destroyed, or is very old.
example_en: The government decided to rebuild the old bridge after the storm.
example_uz: Hukumat bo'rondan keyin eski ko'prikni qayta qurishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: To say something loudly and suddenly, often because you are surprised or excited.
example_en: She was exclaiming with joy when she heard the good news.
example_uz: U xushxabarni eshitib, quvonchdan qichqirib yubordi.

definition_en: A musical instrument made of metal that you play by blowing into it.
example_en: The royal herald sounded a trumpet to announce their arrival.
example_uz: Qirol jarchisi ularning kelganini e'lon qilish uchun karnay chaldi.

definition_en: Objects like bullets or shells that are fired from weapons.
example_en: The soldiers had to reload their weapons because they were out of ammo.
example_uz: O'q-dorilari tugagani uchun askarlar qurollarini qayta o'qlashga majbur bo'lishdi.

definition_en: A very small group of houses in the countryside, smaller than a village.
example_en: We drove through a quiet hamlet on our way to the mountains.
example_uz: Tog'lar sari yo'limizda sokin bir qishloqcha yonidan o'tib ketdik.

definition_en: A person whose job is to make people laugh by telling jokes.
example_en: The comedian told many funny stories that made the audience laugh loudly.
example_uz: Qiziqchi tomoshabinlarni qah-qah urib kuldiradigan ko'plab qiziqarli voqealar aytib berdi.

definition_en: A word used to talk about someone's wife or partner.
example_en: Harry had to go home early because his missus needed his help.
example_uz: Harri uyga erta ketishi kerak edi, chunki ayolining yordamiga ehtiyoji bor edi.

definition_en: A person employed to manage the cleaning and cooking in a house.
example_en: The housekeeper ensures that all the rooms are clean and well prepared.
example_uz: Uy xizmatchisi barcha xonalar ozoda va tartibli bo'lishini nazorat qiladi.

definition_en: Extremely unpleasant, bad, or morally wrong.
example_en: He was arrested for committing a vile crime against an innocent person.
example_uz: U begunoh insonga nisbatan jirkanch jinoyat sodir etgani uchun hibsga olindi.

definition_en: Existing only in your mind and not in the real world.
example_en: As a child, I used to have an imaginary friend at home.
example_uz: Bolaligimda uyda xayoliy do'stim bo'lardi.

definition_en: Large guns used in warfare that are moved on wheels or mounted on vehicles.
example_en: The soldiers prepared the heavy artillery for the upcoming big battle.
example_uz: Askarlar yaqinlashib kelayotgan katta jang uchun og'ir artilleriyani tayyorlashdi.

definition_en: A popular breakfast food made from processed grains, usually eaten with milk.
example_en: Would you like to have some cereal for your breakfast today?
example_uz: Bugun nonushtaga donli mahsulotlardan yeyishni xohlaysizmi?

definition_en: A situation where the opposite of what is expected happens, or using humorous language.
example_en: The irony of the situation was that he failed the easy test.
example_uz: Vaziyatning kinoyasi shunda ediki, u oson imtihondan yiqildi.

definition_en: A long, narrow cut or opening in something.
example_en: The cat escaped through a small slit in the garden fence.
example_uz: Mushuk bog' panjarasidagi kichik tirqishdan chiqib ketdi.

definition_en: To dislike and have no respect for someone or something at all.
example_en: I honestly despise people who treat animals with cruelty and neglect.
example_uz: Rostini aytsam, hayvonlarga nisbatan shafqatsiz va loqayd munosabatda bo'ladigan odamlardan nafratlanaman.

definition_en: A ballroom dance in which partners turn around as they move across the floor.
example_en: The couple performed a beautiful waltz during their wedding reception party.
example_uz: Juftlik to'y ziyofati paytida go'zal vals ijro etdi.

definition_en: The quality of being funny or the ability to laugh at things.
example_en: She has a great sense of humour and always makes me laugh.
example_uz: Uning hazil-mutoyiba tuyg'usi juda kuchli va meni doim kuldiradi.

definition_en: The condition of having difficulty speaking smoothly by repeating the first sounds of words.
example_en: He spoke with a slight stammering that became worse when he was nervous.
example_uz: U asabiylashganda ozgina duduqlanib gapiradigan bo'lib qolardi.

definition_en: To wait for a person or event to happen in a formal way.
example_en: We eagerly await your response regarding the job application next week.
example_uz: Ishga qabul qilish yuzasidan javobingizni intizorlik bilan kutib qolamiz.

definition_en: To feel as if you are about to vomit because of a bad smell or taste.
example_en: The terrible smell from the trash made everyone gag instantly.
example_uz: Axlatxona tomondan kelayotgan badbo'y hid barchaning ko'nglini aynitdi.

definition_en: A person who looks after children for a short time while parents are away.
example_en: We hired a babysitter to look after the kids on Friday night.
example_uz: Juma oqshomi bolalarga qarab turishi uchun enaga yolladik.

definition_en: A state of extreme happiness and complete peace.
example_en: Spending the quiet afternoon at the garden was pure bliss.
example_uz: Bog'da osoyishta o'tgan tushdan keyingi vaqt haqiqiy huzur bag'ishladi.

definition_en: Showing no shame or guilt even when doing something wrong.
example_en: He made a shameless lie to get out of doing his work.
example_uz: U ishini qilmaslik uchun uyalmay yolg'on gapirdi.

definition_en: A layer of earth covered with grass and roots.
example_en: They laid down new turf to make the backyard look green.
example_uz: Hovlini yam-yashil qilish uchun yangi chim yotqizishdi.

definition_en: A strong and sharp flavor or smell.
example_en: The lemon juice added a lovely tang to the fruit salad.
example_uz: Limon suvi mevali salatga o'zgacha o'tkir ta'm qo'shdi.

definition_en: A person trained to study human behavior and treat mental health.
example_en: The psychologist helped her manage stress after her difficult exams.
example_uz: Psixolog unga qiyin imtihonlardan keyin stressni yengishga yordam berdi.

definition_en: Extreme anger or a strong feeling of wanting to punish someone.
example_en: The villagers feared the gods would unleash their wrath upon the land.
example_uz: Qishloqdagilar xudolar o'z g'azabini bu yurtga sochishidan qo'rqishardi.

definition_en: To join pieces of cloth together using a needle and thread.
example_en: She decided to sew a new dress for her daughter's birthday party.
example_uz: U qizining tug'ilgan kuni uchun yangi ko'ylak tikishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: In a calm way without any violence or trouble.
example_en: The elderly man passed away peacefully in his sleep last night.
example_uz: Keksaygan erkak o'tgan kecha uyqusida tinchgina olamdan o'tdi.

definition_en: A piece of old, often dirty cloth used for cleaning.
example_en: He used an old rag to wipe the dust off the shelf.
example_uz: U tokchadagi changni artish uchun eski lattadan foydalandi.

definition_en: Showing a serious and severe manner that expects obedience.
example_en: The teacher gave a stern look to the students talking in class.
example_uz: O'qituvchi darsda gaplashayotgan o'quvchilarga qattiqqo'l nigoh bilan qaradi.

definition_en: A message of sympathy expressed to someone who has lost a loved one.
example_en: I would like to offer my deepest condolences for your tragic loss.
example_uz: Og'ir judoligingiz munosabati bilan chuqur hamdardligimni bildiraman.

definition_en: To pay a very high price for a mistake or bad decision.
example_en: He paid dearly for his mistake in the final exam last year.
example_uz: O'tgan yili imtihondagi xatosi uchun u juda qimmat to'ladi.

definition_en: A feeling of deep shame or loss of pride before other people.
example_en: The team felt great humiliation after losing the match so badly.
example_uz: Jamoa o'yinni bunchalik yomon yutqazgach, juda qattiq xo'rlikni his qildi.

definition_en: The state of showing no politeness or consideration for someone or something.
example_en: His constant rudeness shows a complete lack of respect for others.
example_uz: Uning doimiy qo'polligi boshqalarga nisbatan hurmatsizlikni bildiradi.

definition_en: A sound made to tell someone to be quiet or stop talking.
example_en: Shhh, the baby is finally sleeping in the next room.
example_uz: Pishh, chaqaloq nihoyat yon xonada uxlayapti.

definition_en: The part of society involved in organized crime and illegal activities.
example_en: The local police are trying to investigate links to the underworld.
example_uz: Mahalliy politsiya jinoyatchilar dunyosi bilan bog'liq izlarni tekshirmoqda.

definition_en: Having hair that grows in a curved, spiral shape rather than straight.
example_en: She looks very beautiful with her long and natural curly hair.
example_uz: U uzun va tabiiy jingalak sochlari bilan juda go'zal ko'rinadi.

definition_en: A flat shape with five straight sides and five angles.
example_en: The students drew a perfect pentagon on the blackboard for geometry.
example_uz: O'quvchilar geometriya uchun doskaga mukammal beshburchak chizishdi.

definition_en: A polite word used by a female to address an older man.
example_en: I asked my oppa to help me with my Korean homework yesterday.
example_uz: Kecha koreys tili darsimni bajarishda akamdan yordam so'radim.

definition_en: To pull a vehicle or boat using a rope or chain.
example_en: Our car broke down and we had to tow it to service.
example_uz: Mashinamiz buzilib qoldi va uni servizgacha shatakka olishimizga to'g'ri keldi.

definition_en: To persuade someone to do something wrong or to engage in a sexual relationship.
example_en: The luxury lifestyle was enough to seduce him into quitting his job.
example_uz: Hashamatli turmush tarzi uni ishdan ketishga vasvasaga solish uchun yetarli edi.

definition_en: A large, long container that you fill with water to wash your body.
example_en: I like to relax in the bathtub after a long day's work.
example_uz: Ishdan keyin vannada dam olishni yaxshi ko'raman.

definition_en: A type of small antelope found in the high mountains of Tibet.
example_en: The rare goa can be seen grazing on the vast Tibetan Plateau.
example_uz: Nodir tibet jayronini Tibet platosida o'tlab yurganini ko'rish mumkin.

definition_en: The comparative form of hot, meaning having a higher temperature.
example_en: Today is much hotter than yesterday, so please drink plenty of water.
example_uz: Bugun kechagidan ancha issiqroq, shuning uchun ko'proq suv iching.

definition_en: A strong feeling that someone or something is not important or deserves no respect.
example_en: She looked at the rude man with nothing but complete and utter contempt.
example_uz: U qo'pol odamga nafrat va mensimaslik bilan qaradi.

definition_en: One of the separate areas that a vehicle or container is divided into.
example_en: He opened the small compartment in his bag to find his passport.
example_uz: U pasportini topish uchun sumkasidagi kichik bo'limni ochdi.

definition_en: To move or work in a quick and busy way to get something done.
example_en: We really have to hustle if we want to arrive by nine o'clock.
example_uz: Agar soat to'qqizda yetib bormoqchi bo'lsak, rostdan ham shoshilishimiz kerak.

definition_en: Something that cannot be explained by science or the known laws of nature.
example_en: Many people believe in ghosts and other kinds of supernatural events.
example_uz: Ko'pchilik arvohlar va boshqa g'ayritabiiy hodisalarga ishonadi.

definition_en: A Mexican snack food made of a folded tortilla filled with meat, vegetables, and cheese.
example_en: We went to a local restaurant to eat some delicious beef tacos.
example_uz: Mazali mol go'shtli takolarni yeyish uchun mahalliy restoranga bordik.

definition_en: A group of people organized to work together for a specific purpose or task.
example_en: A volunteer fire brigade helped to extinguish the flames in the forest.
example_uz: Ko'ngilli o't o'chiruvchilar brigadasi o'rmondagi yong'inni o'chirishga yordam berdi.

definition_en: Unable to pay what you owe because you have no money left.
example_en: The business went bankrupt after losing all its major contracts this year.
example_uz: Bu yil barcha yirik shartnomalarni yo'qotgach, biznes bankrot bo'ldi.

definition_en: A person whose job is to watch for danger or someone approaching.
example_en: He acted as a lookout while his friends entered the restricted building.
example_uz: Do'stlari taqiqlangan binoga kirayotganda u kuzatuvchi vazifasini bajardi.

definition_en: Difficult to hold or stand on because it is smooth, wet, or covered in ice.
example_en: Be careful when walking outside, the road is very slippery due to ice.
example_uz: Tashqarida yurganda ehtiyot bo'ling, muz tufayli yo'l juda sirpanchiq.

definition_en: A woman who is married to a duke or holds the rank of a duke.
example_en: The Duchess attended the charity event to support children in need of help.
example_uz: Gersoginya yordamga muhtoj bolalarni qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun xayriya tadbirida qatnashdi.

definition_en: Extremely good, exciting, or excellent in quality.
example_en: We had a ripping time at the party with all our friends.
example_uz: Do'stlarimiz bilan kechada juda ajoyib vaqt o'tkazdik.

definition_en: To go to a particular place in large numbers.
example_en: Thousands of people flocked to the beach during the hot summer weekend.
example_uz: Issiq yoz kunlarida minglab odamlar plyajga oqib kelishdi.

definition_en: A liquid that is believed to have magical or medicinal powers.
example_en: The old witch brewed a magical potion to help the lost boy.
example_uz: Kampir adashib qolgan bolaga yordam berish uchun sehrli ichimlik tayyorladi.

definition_en: A man who is engaged to be married.
example_en: Sarah is going to introduce her fiance to her parents this evening.
example_uz: Sara bugun kechqurun kuyovini ota-onasiga tanishtirmoqchi.

definition_en: A very brief look at someone or something.
example_en: I caught a brief glimpse of the deer before it ran away.
example_uz: Kiyik qochib ketgunicha unga ko'zim tushib qoldi.

definition_en: Too strong to be defeated or overcome by anyone or anything.
example_en: The team felt invincible after winning ten games in a row.
example_uz: Ketma-ket o'nta o'yinda g'alaba qozongach, jamoa o'zini yengilmas his qildi.

definition_en: A metal container used for boiling water for tea or coffee.
example_en: Please put the kettle on so we can have some hot tea.
example_uz: Iltimos, choynakni qaynatib yubor, issiq choy ichamiz.

definition_en: To walk in a slow and relaxed way.
example_en: We decided to stroll through the park after finishing our lunch.
example_uz: Tushlik qilib bo'lgach, bog'da sayr qilishga qaror qildik.

definition_en: A place in a school or workplace where you can buy and eat a meal.
example_en: We met in the school cafeteria to eat lunch together today.
example_uz: Tushlik qilish uchun bugun maktab oshxonasida uchrashdik.

definition_en: Having a healthy and normal mind; able to think clearly and make sensible decisions.
example_en: After such a long and busy day, it is hard to stay sane.
example_uz: Shunchalik uzun va tig'iz kundan keyin sog'lom fikrlash qiyin.

definition_en: A person who is trained to give medical care, especially in the army.
example_en: The army medic quickly bandaged the injured soldier on the battlefield.
example_uz: Harbiy shifokor jang maydonida yarador askarga zudlik bilan bint bog'ladi.

definition_en: To look at something secretly or quickly, usually for a short time.
example_en: Do not peek at your presents before your birthday party starts.
example_uz: Tug'ilgan kuning boshlanmasidan oldin sovg'alaringga mo'ralama.

definition_en: A large pipe underground that carries waste water and sewage away from buildings.
example_en: The city workers are repairing the damaged sewer under the main street.
example_uz: Shahar ishchilari asosiy ko'cha ostidagi shikastlangan kanalizatsiya quvurini ta'mirlashmoqda.

definition_en: An amphibian that looks like a frog but has drier skin and shorter legs.
example_en: The toad hopped slowly across the damp grass near the small pond.
example_uz: Baqa kichik hovuz yaqinidagi nam o'tlar ustidan sekin sakrab o'tdi.

definition_en: A large deer with big flat antlers that lives in cold northern forests.
example_en: We saw a moose standing at the edge of the thick woods.
example_uz: Biz quyuq o'rmon chetida turgan losni ko'rdik.

definition_en: A single movement of a needle in sewing or a loop of thread.
example_en: She added one final stitch to fix the hole in her sweater.
example_uz: U sviteridagi teshikni yopish uchun oxirgi bitta chok qo'ydi.

definition_en: A tool with a magnetic needle that shows you which direction is north.
example_en: The explorer used a compass to find his way through the forest.
example_uz: Sayohatchi o'rmon ichida yo'lini topish uchun kompasdan foydalandi.

definition_en: To not like someone or something.
example_en: I dislike the taste of olives so I never eat them.
example_uz: Men zaytun ta'mini yomon ko'raman, shuning uchun uni umuman yemayman.

definition_en: One of the curved bones in the chest protecting your heart and lungs.
example_en: He broke a rib while playing football with his friends yesterday.
example_uz: U kecha do'stlari bilan futbol o'ynayotganda qovurg'asini sindirib oldi.

definition_en: To prepare yourself physically or mentally for something difficult or unpleasant.
example_en: You should brace yourself for some bad news about the project.
example_uz: Loyiha haqidagi yomon xabarga o'zingni tayyorlab qo'yishing kerak.

definition_en: To push something or someone suddenly and with a lot of force.
example_en: They tried to thrust the new responsibilities upon me without asking.
example_uz: Ular so'ramasdan, yangi majburiyatlarni zimmamga yuklamoqchi bo'lishdi.

definition_en: A place where monks live and work together away from the outside world.
example_en: The old monastery is located high up in the quiet mountains.
example_uz: Qadimiy monastir baland va sokin tog'larda joylashgan.

definition_en: Feeling annoyed because you have to wait or things are taking too long.
example_en: He became impatient when the bus did not arrive on time.
example_uz: Avtobus vaqtida kelmagach, u toqati toq bo'lib kutishdan charchadi.

definition_en: The state of lacking knowledge, information, or education about something.
example_en: Their ignorance of the local customs led to some awkward social situations.
example_uz: Ularning mahalliy urf-odatlarni bilmasligi noqulay vaziyatlarga sabab bo'ldi.

definition_en: Having a well-organized society with advanced social, moral, and cultural standards.
example_en: We should resolve our disagreements in a civilized and respectful manner.
example_uz: Biz kelishmovchiliklarimizni madaniyatli va hurmatli yo'l bilan hal qilishimiz kerak.

definition_en: A blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to other parts of the body.
example_en: High blood pressure can cause serious damage to your main artery.
example_uz: Yuqori qon bosimi asosiy arteriyangizga jiddiy zarar yetkazishi mumkin.

definition_en: A recorded voice that speaks over a film or television program without being seen.
example_en: The documentary features a voiceover explaining the history of the ancient city.
example_uz: Hujjatli filmda qadimiy shahar tarixini tushuntirib beruvchi diktor ovozi eshitiladi.

definition_en: A strong stone fortress or a building used as a place of safety.
example_en: We visited the historic Ark of Bukhara during our trip to Uzbekistan.
example_uz: O‘zbekistonga safarimiz davomida tarixiy Buxoro arkini ko‘rib keldik.

definition_en: A person who builds or repairs structures made of wood.
example_en: The carpenter used his tools to build a new wooden table for us.
example_uz: Duradgor o‘z asboblari yordamida biz uchun yangi yog‘och stol yasadi.

definition_en: Making someone feel sad, worried, or uncomfortable.
example_en: It was very upsetting to hear the bad news about my friend.
example_uz: Do‘stim haqidagi yomon xabarni eshitish juda iztirobli edi.

definition_en: To pretend you have something to gain an advantage over others.
example_en: He did not actually have a winning hand, so he decided to bluff.
example_uz: Uning qo‘lida aslida yutadigan karta yo‘q edi, shuning uchun u aldab ko‘rishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: So painful or unpleasant that it is impossible to tolerate.
example_en: The heat during the summer afternoon was simply unbearable for everyone.
example_uz: Yozgi tush paytidagi issiqqa hamma ham chidab bo‘lmas edi.

definition_en: Illegal drugs that affect the mind or body and are used for non-medical purposes.
example_en: The government has launched a new campaign to stop the sale of narcotics.
example_uz: Hukumat narkotiklar savdosiga qarshi kurashish uchun yangi kampaniya boshladi.

definition_en: Full of juice and pleasant to eat; also, very interesting and exciting information.
example_en: I bit into the juicy peach and felt refreshed on a hot day.
example_uz: Issiq kunda shirin shaftolini tishlab, tetiklashib qoldim.

definition_en: Strange and frightening in a way that makes you feel uneasy.
example_en: An eerie silence fell over the forest as the sun went down.
example_uz: Quyosh botishi bilan o'rmonda g'alati sukunat hukm surdi.

definition_en: A word representing the sound of a kiss, often used in messages.
example_en: Thanks for your help, mwah, see you later tonight!
example_uz: Yordaming uchun rahmat, mua, kechqurun ko'rishamiz!

definition_en: Soft, comfortable shoes that you wear only inside your house.
example_en: Please take off your shoes and put on these comfortable slippers.
example_uz: Iltimos, oyoq kiyimingizni yechib, mana bu yumshoq shippaklarni kiying.
